def is_valid_subdomain(subdomain: str) -> bool:
    # Basic validation: subdomain must not contain invalid characters
    if not subdomain or not subdomain.strip():
        return False
    if any(char in '()[]{}' for char in subdomain):
        return False
    return True

# Example usage
print(is_valid_subdomain("subdomain"))      # True
print(is_valid_subdomain("a.b"))            # True

print(is_valid_subdomain("subdomain.com"))  # False (subdomain is actually a domain)
